summary: Wrote the homily entrypoint homily.tex and its two declared components, sections/homily/10-homily.tex (about 1,400 spoken words, about 10.8-11.7 minutes at 120-130 words a minute by arithmetic, not timed) and sections/homily/90-note.tex (source-and-delivery note with exact loci and References), refreshed the shared revision timestamp, and appended the derive-homily record to research/production-review.md. The speech asks once how the Gradual's promise of no want can be true of saints who went hungry and were killed, and answers it chiefly from the third interpretation (Augustine's objector, Basil's dilemma and 'God himself', Aquinas's help in need and physician, with their difference kept; Augustine on Wis 3:1; Bernard on the night-office verse), joined to the present tense of Mt 5:3 and 5:10, the Offertory and Secret, the Lesson's multitude, the Collect and Postcommunion, the Communion and the Introit; the decisive textual detail is recorded in the production audit. The build settled cleanly (4 pages, SHA-256 fde1946bac776bd192c5d825497b529d142a3494884b422b79387a1f5c37faff); check-proper-components (content and artifacts, homily edition) and every check-content-preflight check for the homily edition, including provenance-matches-run, pass. This dispatch contributed the homily for All Saints and its source-and-delivery note, derived from the reviewed expansive and concise studies. No upstream defect was found; make check-sources fails only on the expected installed-PDF and publication-inventory staleness owned by later stages.
